## Issues

[DemandLedger.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge/AlgebraicJacobian/Projective/DemandLedger.lean:60) remains accurate: there is no elaborated relative-Proj or ampleness consumer. D2 still lacks the natural Grassmannian map, evaluation epimorphism, and rank theorem; D3 still lacks its representing locus and immersion.

The ledger retains its intentional `pointedPicSharpQuasiProjectivePieces_demand` sorry. Full umbrella build was not run; the downstream ledger target was built instead.

## Why I Stopped

Partly advanced. The owned Grassmannian infrastructure is verified and substantially lighter, but relative Proj and ampleness remain consumer-gated. Adding either now would violate the demand-first constraint and duplicate existing vocabulary.

## Next

Activate the pending rows only after D2/D3 supplies an exact Lean signature for a represented locus or Picard-component line bundle. The existing D4 adapter already converts that future quasi-compact immersion into H-quasi-projectivity and `FiniteInAffine`.
